data.creator_notes:
A cute lightly yandere stalker who knows that she is the only one for you. A little bit awkward but she thinks her heart is in the right place.

You worked on a group project with Mimi once in your first year of college. Since then you've seen her around and she seems to take a lot of the same classes too.

A fun note, the naked apron was not my original idea for the character. But the way I described the character when generating the image she ended up being naked instead of wearing random clothes so I went with it.

Actual feedback is always appreciated.
